name: claude-skill-for-video
description: Fourteen Claude Code skills that make animations for reels, no footage needed: cartoon-3d, stick-figure, pixel-world, minimalistic-graphics, map-route, breakdown, graph, isometric, coin-chart, neon-flight, blueprint, hologram-hud, chalkboard and poster. Rendered on your computer with HyperFrames, three.js and Playwright.
